original_query: SELECT SUM(SAL) AS SUM_SAL, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN JOB = 'CLERK' THEN DEPTNO ELSE NULL END) AS COUNT_DISTINCT_CLERK, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 10 THEN SAL ELSE NULL END) AS SUM_SAL_D10, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 20 THEN SAL ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_SAL_D20, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNT_D30, COUNT(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 40 THEN 'x' ELSE NULL END) AS COUNT_D40, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 45 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS COUNT_D45, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 50 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS COUNT_D50, SUM(CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19, 9))) AS SUM_NULL_D60, SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 70 THEN NULL ELSE 1 END) AS SUM_NULL_D70, COUNT(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 20 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS COUNT_D20 FROM EMP
rewritten_query:
WITH dept_agg AS (
    SELECT
        DEPTNO,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(SAL) AS sum_sal,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN JOB = 'CLERK' THEN 1 END) AS clerk_cnt
    FROM EMP
    GROUP BY DEPTNO
)
SELECT
    SUM(sum_sal) AS SUM_SAL,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN DEPTNO IS NOT NULL AND clerk_cnt > 0 THEN 1 END) AS COUNT_DISTINCT_CLERK,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 10 THEN sum_sal END) AS SUM_SAL_D10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 20 THEN sum_sal ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_SAL_D20,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 30 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS COUNT_D30,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 40 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS COUNT_D40,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 45 THEN cnt END) AS BIGINT) AS COUNT_D45,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 50 THEN cnt END) AS BIGINT) AS COUNT_D50,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19, 9)) AS SUM_NULL_D60,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 70 THEN NULL ELSE cnt END) AS BIGINT) AS SUM_NULL_D70,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DEPTNO = 20 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS COUNT_D20
FROM dept_agg;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Pre-aggregate EMP by DEPTNO in a CTE (cnt, sum_sal, clerk_cnt), reducing the outer aggregation to the number of distinct departments and enabling HashAggregate instead of sorting.

Replace COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN JOB='CLERK' THEN DEPTNO END) with COUNT(CASE WHEN DEPTNO IS NOT NULL AND clerk_cnt > 0 THEN 1 END) over department-level groups, eliminating the expensive distinct sort over 45M rows.
SUM(CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,9))) is always NULL regardless of input, so fold it to a scalar NULL cast.

Preserve original empty-table semantics: use COALESCE only for COUNT-based outputs (COUNT_D40, COUNT_D20) which return 0 on empty input; leave SUM-based outputs (COUNT_D30, D45, D50, SUM_NULL_D70) un-coalesced since the original SUM returns NULL on empty input.
